Automated and consistent investigation for all alert types, known and unknown, at the speed and scale of AI. Radiant filters out the noise from your analysts and escalates only real threats for review.

Transparent reasoning for every AI decision 

Every escalation and dismissal includes full traceability and investigation context: which data sources were queried, what patterns were detected, and why the AI reached its conclusion. 

See How 

Executable response plans 

Respond to every escalated incident within minutes without creating playbooks. Automate for future incidents, or launch manually with one click to maintain full analyst control.

A security data lake without SIEM constraints 

Store, search, and analyze all your security logs in one place with unlimited retention and zero vendor lock-in. Reduce logging costs by up to 85% with transparent, predictable, and scalable pricing.

AI Triage and research agents investigate every alert, across every use case, with the depth and reasoning of your best analyst.
